titulo: A lid on the mug, hot to the last sip
caption:
A lid on the mug, hot to the last sip

The tea was steaming. A lid went on the mug, and it was still hot at the last sip.

A lid on the mug keeps the tea hot for twenty minutes, not two.

For whoever puts a lid on the mug so the tea stays hot.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and a cream mug with steam on it at the right. A small plum lid lies at the middle of the table. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the lid hops in an arc and lands on the mug, and the steam stops. A small sparkle lights above. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, keeping it hot.
